mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO news_snapshot (news_no, news_date, news_time, title, raw_json) VALUES
(#{v.newsNo}, #{v.newsDate}, #{v.newsTime}, #{v.title}, #{v.rawJson})
ON CONFLICT (news_no) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, news_no, news_date, news_time, title, raw_json FROM news_snapshot ORDER BY news_date DESC, news_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
